title: open source auto farm money
script:
local Xeno = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itay299/RobloxScripts/main/Scripts/!MyLibrary"))()
local UI = Xeno:Create("Ban or Get Banned 🔨", game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId).Name)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- vars
local autoBuy = false
local autoFarm = false

local bans = {
	"Ban5Min",
	"Ban15Min",
	"Ban30Min",
	"Ban1Hour",
	"Ban1Day",
	"Ban30Days",
	"Ban365Days"
}

-- toggles
UI:Toggle("Auto Buy Bans", false, function(v)
	autoBuy = v
end)

UI:Toggle("Auto Farm Money", false, function(v)
	autoFarm = v
end)

-- auto buy loop
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if autoBuy then
			for _, ban in ipairs(bans) do
				ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ShopBuyBan"):FireServer(ban)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
end)

-- auto farm loop
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if autoFarm then
			local char = player.Character
			if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-1.5, 2066, -101)
			end
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)
